summary.headline: Astrological and Medical Chapter List
summary.text: Continuation of a Florentine codex catalogue, listing astrological and medical chapters on the beginning of the month, the seven stars, cooling and heating, decumbiture, childbirth, phlebotomy, surgery, purgation, disease prognostication, and methods attributed to Hermes Trismegistus, Galen, Pancharius, Hephaestion, Petosiris, Astrampsychus, Stephen of Alexandria, and Theophilus. It also records chapters on seasonal time transfers, inceptions, and the royal lot, with manuscript folio references and comparisons to other codices.
